findings.before: Explicit GenerationRequest(mode=native_mlx,use_cache=True) obtains a cached baseline prefix but sends the whole prompt to native stream_generate, consuming prefix twice. native_generate helper disables cache and was unaffected.
findings.after: Native generator receives tokens[hit:] with the matching consumed-prefix state.

findings.before: Explicit memory budget adds logical retained snapshot bytes to MLX active memory, which already owns those arrays; usable cache hit may be cleared or request rejected.
findings.after: Compare active allocator bytes plus conservative future KV reserve only; logical cache bytes remain the admission limit and are not physical extra memory.
findings.evidence: Explicit-budget parameter of cached-native portable test: active100 + reserve2064 fits budget2168; logical snapshot8 must not be added again.

mechanism_review.cache_tail_and_ownership: Inspected locked MLX-LM trie/trim implementation; facade leaves one uncached input; nontrimmable exact full hit falls back to earlier exact snapshot. Stored snapshots deep-copied before mutable request ownership; cancellation/branch cannot mutate prior snapshot. No arbitrary hybrid trim introduced.
